title: InsForge
description: Exposes an InsForge project's REST API as agent tools.
Covers PostgREST-style record queries, inserts, updates, upserts and deletes,
database function (RPC) calls, and storage bucket listing, download URLs and deletes.
Read-only by default; mutating tools require writes to be enabled.

insforge.project_url.title: Project URL
insforge.project_url.description: Base URL of the InsForge project, e.g. https://your-app.insforge.app. A self-hosted deployment's own origin works too. Falls back to the ROCKETRIDE_INSFORGE_URL environment variable when empty.

insforge.api_key.title: API Key
insforge.api_key.description: InsForge API key or JWT, sent as a Bearer token. Row-level security applies to whatever this credential authorizes, so prefer a scoped key over an admin one. Falls back to the ROCKETRIDE_INSFORGE_KEY environment variable when empty.

insforge.allow_writes.title: Allow writes
insforge.allow_writes.description: Permit the agent to insert, update, upsert and delete records, call database functions, and delete stored objects. Leave OFF unless the agent is meant to change the backend — query and listing tools work either way.
